profile.headline: Scrum Master at Cisco
profile.summary: My name is Philip Green, the scrum master for the PLUIUX Development Team at Cisco Systems. With over 10 years of experience in agile environments and a strong background as a Scrum Master and Software Engineer at Cisco Systems, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to a team’s success.

positions.title: Scrum Master / Frontend Developer
positions.description: Skills: Agile Project Management · Agile Application Development · Kanban · Scrum · Troubleshooting · Problem Solving · Sprint Planning · Office Administration · Git · Communication · Agile Methodologies · Agile Leadership · Project Management · Analytical Skills · Scaled Agile Framework · Bug Tracking · User Stories · Agile Web Development · Agile Environment · Confluence · Sprint Backlog · Project Implementation · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Front-End Development · Stakeholder Relations · Team Development · Defect Tracking · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and optimized responsive React and Node.js web applications for thousands of active users, resulting in a 10% increase in user engagement and improved load speeds.

Technical Stack & Workflow

• Modern Web Fundamentals: Expert in HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript using Tailwind and Bootstrap to build responsive, high-performance interfaces.

• Quality Assurance: Designed and implemented automated end-to-end testing suites using Cypress, boosting code coverage to 80% and reducing post-release bugs by 90%.

• Version Control: Manage source code and team collaboration through Git and GitHub for efficient branching and repository maintenance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primarily responsible for writing codes and test software using HTML 5, SASS, SCSS and CSS for Cisco Collaborative Knowledge, a digital workplace solution can help you solve business challenges by accessing knowledge, experts, and learning in real time.

Technical Stack & Workflow

• Full-Stack Application Development: Built and deployed scalable, responsive web and mobile applications leveraging a diverse modern tech stack, including React.js, Node.js, Ember.js, Bootstrap, WordPress, and Drupal.

• Large-Scale Data Architecture: Engineered complex enterprise applications utilizing Ember.js to efficiently process, render, and manage large-scale user databases without sacrificing application speed.

• User-Centric Responsive Design: Developed cross-platform mobile and web interfaces rooted in strict UI/UX design principles, using advanced fluid CSS to ensure perfect responsiveness across all device sizes.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Built and optimized responsive React and Node.js web applications for thousands of active users, resulting in a 10% increase in user engagement and improved load speeds.

Technical Stack & Workflow

• Custom Theme Development: Converted complex PSD designs into fully responsive, custom WordPress themes using clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• E-Commerce & CMS Management: Built and managed Shopify and WordPress web applications, utilizing their respective CMS platforms to execute full CRUD operations and custom code modifications.

• SEO & Performance Optimization: Utilized Ahrefs.com, GTmetrix.com and Google Analytics to audit web traffic, diagnose technical bottlenecks, improve site speeds, and implement data-driven SEO strategies.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Architected, developed, and optimized 16 public-facing and intranet web platforms dedicated to supporting and delivering critical environmental resources to Tribal communities across America. Partnered with federal stakeholders to build accessible, secure, and user-centric applications using modern JavaScript frameworks.

Technical Stack & Workflow

• Component-Driven Infrastructure: Engineered accessible web portals using Vue.js, JavaScript, and semantic HTML/CSS to build modular, reusable UI components across 16 distinct EPA intranet ecosystems.

• Rigorous Quality Assurance: Formulated and executed stringent compliance testing strategies—combining manual protocols and automated testing frameworks—to ensure data accuracy, Section 508 accessibility compliance, and bug-free federal deployments.

• Responsive Cross-Platform Access: Built fluid, mobile-first interfaces utilizing advanced CSS, ensuring tribal leaders and community members nationwide could reliably access complex environmental data on any device or bandwidth limit.

positions.title: ProV International
positions.description:
ProV's primary business model is to provide end-to-end IT services and solutions to its global clients.
The main products of ProV are the IT consultants in the various disciplines, which are used to
supplement an organization's internal needs or to provide a low cost alternative to an organization's IT
staff.  My role at ProV International as a Ruby On Rails Developer was;
Created the implementation for features for a website to perform special functions.  
Created the design, implementation and using RSpec to test Ruby codes during development
Editing previous Ruby on Rails application codes and using them in new applications
Used Hpricot and Devise to enhance the website's functionality and features
Implemented CSS  along with HAML to build websites  

Client Focused  -  "Web Developer"

positions.title: Publications Developer
positions.description:
AICPA members represent many areas of practice, including business and industry, public practice,
government, education and consulting; membership is also available to accounting students and CPA
candidates. The AICPA sets ethical standards for the profession and U.S. auditing standards for audits
of private companies, non-profit organizations, federal, state and local governments. It develops and
grades the Uniform CPA Examination.  My role at AICPA as a Publications Developer was;
Write and edit text for monthly and quarterly publications using Adobe InDesign
Create graphics to accompany text
Create proposals
Translate electronic information into PDF's

CrossComm  -  "Web Developer"		(February - May 2011)
CrossComm values their client's goals and long-term success. Therefore CrossComm places a
high premium on building strong, healthy business partnerships that will stand the test of time. Two of
their foundational goals as a company are to provide a complete online solution for our clients and to
continually stay on top of new technical developments.  They are able to offer services in online
consulting, brand development, design, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), website production, and
high-level programming. We have developed ecommerce sites, iPhone applications, and flexible
databases, as well as Visual Identity Manuals and email marketing campaigns. Our programmers have
experience in a wide array of platforms and languages, including Javascript, Ruby on Rails, Objective C, and Unity.  My role at CrossComm as Web Developer was;
Edit website content using  Adobe Dreamweaver
Write and edit PHP scripts for various web sites
Perform content management using FTP clients

Freelance
